This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with editor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The plugin grants the edit_feeds capability to the Editor role on activation, meaning any Editor-level user satisfies the authorization checks and can exploit this vulnerability.

cwes.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

summary: Vulnerability due to inadequate restriction of references to external XML entities in OpenKM...
description: Vulnerability due to inadequate restriction of references to external XML entities in OpenKM Community Edition. The XML processing in FormUtils / LocalEntityResolver does not properly restrict the resolution of external resources. An authenticated remote attacker with the ROLE_USER role can exploit the flaw via a REST request. In the 6.3.x branch, this allows the attacker to trigger HTTP requests under their control (SSRF); in 7.0.3, it allows the attacker to read local files and access internal HTTP resources from the server.

cwes.name: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

summary: The MISP Modules website component contains an open redirect vulnerability in its login endpoint....
description: The MISP Modules website component contains an open redirect vulnerability in its login endpoint. The /login route accepted a user-supplied next query parameter and passed it directly to Flask's redirect() function without validating the destination. An attacker could craft a URL such as https://victim-host/login?next=https://attacker.example/phish and deliver it to a user (e.g., via email or a lookalike page). After the user successfully authenticated, the application issued a 302 redirect to the attacker-controlled external URL. This enables phishing attacks where a user, believing they are still on the legitimate MISP Modules site, may enter additional credentials or sensitive information on the attacker's page. It can also be used to obscure the true destination of a link, bypassing user trust in the legitimate domain. The vulnerability requires the victim to interact with the crafted URL and complete a login, but no prior authentication or special configuration is needed on the attacker's side. The affected component is the website sub-project of misp-modules, specifically the account blueprint in website/app/account/account.py. No version boundaries are specified in the patch metadata.

cwes.name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site

This allows the attacker to impersonate any user, including administrators.
This issue was fixed in version 5.10.2607.  Hotfixes for older versions (5.8) have also been released.

cwes.name: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature
